direction: SPY/IEF/GLD: isolate diversification, then incremental monthly trend filtering
selection_policy: Fixed contemporary research universe by equity/Treasury/gold roles, not survivor-free market selection or highest past return; no symbol substitution.

rules.monthly_spy: Target100%SPY before reserve; rebalance monthly at next open.
rules.static_equal_thirds: Target1/3 each SPY/IEF/GLD before reserve; rebalance monthly at next open.
rules.equal_thirds_10m_trend_cash: At each completed month-end, a sleeve receives1/3 only if its forward-constructed total-return index exceeds its trailing10month-end mean including current month. Otherwise that sleeve stays cash, without redistribution.

future_study.decision_fill: Last common completed regular session of month; next common regular session open. Never same-close fill; daily bars cannot validate intraday execution.
future_study.dates_status: Proposed pending audited inception/common coverage/calendar and full10month warmup; no pre-inception backfill or automatic date/proxy amendment.
future_study.primary_cash_model: One USD CASH account. No borrowing. Sell-before-buy; buys use realized available cash after all modeled costs. Unpaid dividend receivables belong to wealth but are excluded from spendable cash/investable target budget.
future_study.dividends: Entitle prior eligible holdings at documented ex-date; accrue receivable; credit spendable cash only at verified payment date under declared date-level ordering. Unknown pay dates block primary tradable-cash study; do not fabricate them.
future_study.splits: Preserve raw execution prices and adjust quantities/entitlements per verified effective split action/order. Do not treat split movement as profit/loss or double-adjust.
future_study.signal_series: Forward total-return index from verified raw prices, distributions and splits; explicitly chosen reinvestment convention for signals only, separate from actual payment-cash availability. Do not use adjusted fills plus duplicate dividends.
future_study.rebalance: Use available open marks; fixed deterministic symbol order after sells, cost-aware whole-share cash feasibility, residual cash retained. Rejections/partial fills do not create assumed cash; missing marks stop/flag rather than forward-fill.
future_study.primary_criterion: At each cost: no worse full-path drawdown magnitude AND longest observed peak-to-recovery/observed-end sessions, strictly better at leastone. Drawdown fraction tolerance1e-10; duration integerexact. Cost-robustclaimrequiresbothcontexts.
future_study.growth: Report CAGR/endingwealth sacrifice separately; acceptable sacrifice not selected; path pass is not investment selection.
future_study.chronology: Continuous capital/positions/features, no annual resets. Previously viewed/publicly studied2006–2025 remains development; new tickers do not create holdout independence.
future_study.cash_comparison: Zero-return analytical cash under zero cash interest; undefined Sharpe/Calmar. Actual opportunity cost disclosed; do not import an undeclared cash-yield benefit.

native_readiness: Single sharedcash account andthree instrument identities
Independent Decimal reconciliation or precise native blockinggap
prohibited: Historical performance execution in readiness phase
stop: Stop source/probe work at limits/deadline or integrity failure, preserveattempts, return explicit not-ready gaps. No hidden retries, third provider, split-adjusted proxy splice or automatic market-case launch.
